newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Golden Power to place 38 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: Golden Power to place 38 mln new shares.

text.p: Golden Power International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it had arranged to privately place 38 million new shares, or 16.51 percent of the enlarged share capital, to third party investors at HK$0.50 per share, equivalent to its closing price on Tuesday.
China Everbright Securities (HK) Ltd is the placing agent.
On completion, aggregate shareholding of the company's controlling shareholders including its chairman Chung King Shing will be diluted to 42.50 percent from 50.90 percent.
Golden Power said net proceeds of HK$18 million would be used for general working capital.
Golden Power is a manufacturer of batteries, semi-finished and finished electronic products and a distributor of electronic parts and components.
